msg_help: %s AQI Notifier Bot This bot monitors air quality data from your sensors and sends notifications about threshold exceedances or sharp changes. Main Commands: /list — your subscriptions and management /status — current data for all your devices /history — history of recent measurements /help — this help message Management: • Press %s My Subscriptions to add or remove a device. • In the settings section (%s Settings), you can change thresholds, intervals, and notification types. • Notifications for entering the "red zone" and back are sent with sound. Others (dynamic changes) are silent.
msg_already_sub: %s You are already subscribed to device %s
msg_no_subs: %s You have no active subscriptions. Press %s Subscribe to add a device.
msg_your_subs: %s Your subscriptions: Click on a device for data or use the buttons below for management.
msg_settings_title: %s Monitoring Settings Select a section to configure personal notifications.
msg_thresholds_menu: %s Pollution Thresholds %s PM10 Threshold: %.1f %s PM2.5 Threshold: %.1f Select a threshold to change.
msg_interval_prompt: %s Comparison Interval Current interval: %d sec. Enter new value in seconds (e.g., 3600 for an hour):
msg_sound_settings: Click on a notification type to enable or disable it:
msg_invalid_device_id: %s Device ID must contain only digits.
